attempts.exactPrompt:

findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection preserves Ianar's mature 29-year-old adult identity: deep band-6 skin, heart-tapered face, close-set eyes, high arched brows, short rounded nose, wide closed mouth, defined adult jaw, and faint stubble remain recognizable rather than becoming a baby or generic doll face.

The chibi keeps Ianar's short clearly-muscular construction through compact height language, broad readable shoulders and back, developed torso and legs, and source-coherent muscular mass without generic body inflation.

Both upper arms and forearms retain pronounced muscular definition, with coherent wrists and two distinct empty hands; hand scale stays source-consistent with no fusion, swelling, or duplicate anatomy.
Dark-brown curls and coils preserve the summon source's dense halo, front and side construction, loose face-framing falls, and high gathered coil mass without color, parting, or accent drift.

The plum-gray asymmetric patchwork, overlapping uneven hems, extensive visible repairs, low-profile toggles, practical trousers, articulated patched knees, wraps, and boots remain source-faithful. Both combat hands are empty, and no tattoo, jewelry, prop, or undeclared accessory was added.

The complete high-coil hair-top-to-chin unit occupies approximately 40% of standing height, about 2.5 heads total. This is materially above the frozen 32-36% / 2.75-3.1-head range even though the compact body otherwise reads as chibi; the gate explicitly includes the full hair mass.

Exactly one coherent full-body subject appears with the entire high coil mass, head, both empty hands, all garment edges, both legs, both boots, and grounding shadow fully inside generous safe margins.
A broad staggered stance, bent compact limbs, lowered center of gravity, separated empty hands, forward three-quarter torso, and steady gaze create a clean grounded weaponless ready-idle silhouette.

The presentation remains repaired ordinary cloth, practical trousers, wraps, and worn boots on a parchment wash, with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
